ontology.title: Basel-derived G-SIB Markets and Lending Activity Ontology
ontology.description: Hierarchical multi-label ontology for financial-news classification by materially described G-SIB business activity.
ontology.changes: Adds per-node label, yes_no_question and criteria{true,false}, and appends exclusions for known hard boundaries. Node IDs, hierarchy, names and types are unchanged.

relevance.name: Relevance
relevance.question: Which relevance categories apply to this article?
relevance.definition: Routes articles between material G-SIB activity, financial-market context without such activity, and out-of-scope content.

relevance.gsib_activity.name: G-SIB Activity
relevance.gsib_activity.question: Which G-SIB business arms are materially implicated by the article?
relevance.gsib_activity.definition: Material Markets, Lending, or Treasury/ALM activity performed by a large universal bank.
excludes: central-bank policy decision without dealer activity
relevance.gsib_activity.label: bank or dealer lending, underwriting, or trading
relevance.gsib_activity.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank, dealer, or lender doing business, such as lending, underwriting, trading, market making, financing clients, or managing its own funding?

criteria.true: A bank or dealer's lending, deal, trade, client financing, or funding activity is reported, or a bank business line's results or strategy are discussed.
criteria.false: Only prices, economic data, policy, or non-bank company news, with no bank or dealer activity described.

relevance.market_context_only.name: Market Context Only
relevance.market_context_only.definition: Financial-market, issuer, macroeconomic, policy, or asset-price context without a material G-SIB activity.
relevance.market_context_only.label: market, economic, or company news without bank activity
relevance.market_context_only.yes_no_question: Is the article about financial markets, the economy, policy, or companies, without describing any bank or dealer lending, underwriting, trading for clients, or financing?

criteria.true: Market moves, prices, economic data, central-bank or government policy, or company news, with no bank or dealer business activity described.
criteria.false: A bank or dealer activity is described, or the article is not about markets or the economy at all.

relevance.neither.name: Neither / Out of Scope
relevance.neither.definition: Content neither materially about G-SIB business activity nor relevant financial-market context.
relevance.neither.label: unrelated to finance or the economy
relevance.neither.yes_no_question: Is the article unrelated to financial markets, the economy, and banking?

criteria.true: General news such as sport, culture, crime, weather, or non-financial human-interest stories.
criteria.false: Any financial-market, economic, policy, company, or banking content is discussed.

business.markets.name: Markets
business.markets.question: Which Markets business families are materially described or implicated?
business.markets.definition: Client-facing trading, market making, securities and derivatives activity, securities financing, structured products, underwriting, and syndication.
business.markets.label: bank trading, underwriting, or derivatives business
business.markets.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer trading, making markets, underwriting or syndicating deals, providing derivatives, or financing clients' securities positions?

criteria.true: Sales and trading, market making, derivatives, securities financing, structured products, or underwriting activity by a bank or dealer is reported.
criteria.false: Only asset prices or issuer news, or bank lending that is held as a loan with no markets activity.

business.lending.name: Lending
business.lending.question: Which Lending business families are materially described or implicated?
business.lending.definition: Provision, commitment, arrangement, or management of loans and credit facilities.
business.lending.label: bank loan or credit facility
business.lending.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or lender providing, committing, arranging, or managing a loan or credit facility?

criteria.true: A loan, revolver, credit line, mortgage, trade facility, or other credit extension by a bank or lender is reported.
criteria.false: Only securities trading, underwriting of bonds or shares, or borrowing that is not from a bank or lender.

business.treasury_alm.name: Treasury / ALM
business.treasury_alm.question: Which Treasury or asset-liability-management activities are materially described?
business.treasury_alm.definition: Bank balance-sheet funding, liquidity management, structural interest-rate risk, and structural FX.
excludes: central-bank liquidity operations described only from the central bank's side
business.treasury_alm.label: bank managing its own funding or liquidity
business.treasury_alm.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank managing its own funding, liquidity, or balance-sheet interest-rate or currency risk?

criteria.true: A bank's own funding raising, liquidity buffers, deposit or wholesale funding strategy, or structural rate/FX hedging is reported.
criteria.false: Client trading, client financing, or central-bank policy without a bank's own balance-sheet management.

treasury.funding.name: Treasury Funding
treasury.funding.definition: Bank-level wholesale or secured funding undertaken for balance-sheet funding.
treasury.funding.label: bank raising its own funding
treasury.funding.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank raising funding for its own balance sheet, for example by issuing its own bonds, covered bonds, or using wholesale or secured funding?

criteria.true: A bank's own funding transaction or funding plan is reported.
criteria.false: The bank finances a client, or only the funding market in general is discussed.

treasury.liquidity.name: Liquidity Management
treasury.liquidity.definition: Management of bank liquidity resources, liquidity buffer, and liquid-asset portfolio.
treasury.liquidity.label: bank liquidity buffer management
treasury.liquidity.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank managing its liquidity, liquidity buffer, or holdings of high-quality liquid assets?

criteria.true: A bank's liquidity position, buffers, LCR, HQLA holdings, or liquidity actions are reported.
criteria.false: Market liquidity in general, or a central bank providing liquidity with no bank-side management described.

treasury.structural_rates.name: Structural Interest-Rate Risk
treasury.structural_rates.definition: Management of structural interest-rate exposure arising from the banking book.
excludes: interest-rate forecast without bank balance-sheet management
treasury.structural_rates.label: bank hedging its own interest-rate risk
treasury.structural_rates.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank managing or hedging the interest-rate risk on its own balance sheet?

criteria.true: A bank's banking-book rate exposure, net-interest-income hedging, or IRRBB management is reported.
criteria.false: Rates trading for clients, or general interest-rate moves.

treasury.structural_fx.name: Structural FX
treasury.structural_fx.definition: Management or hedging of structural foreign-exchange exposure arising from the bank balance sheet.
treasury.structural_fx.label: bank hedging its own currency risk
treasury.structural_fx.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank managing or hedging currency risk on its own balance sheet or capital?

criteria.true: A bank's structural FX exposure, capital hedging, or translation-risk management is reported.
criteria.false: FX trading for clients, or general currency moves.

markets.macro.name: Macro Markets
markets.macro.question: Which Macro Markets activities are materially described?
markets.macro.definition: Client-facing trading or market making in rates, FX, commodities, inflation, or emerging-markets macro products.
excludes: government bond yield move without dealer activity
markets.macro.label: dealer trading rates, currencies, or commodities
markets.macro.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer trading or making markets in government bonds, interest-rate products, currencies, commodities, inflation products, or emerging-market macro instruments?

criteria.true: Dealer or bank trading, market making, or client flows in rates, FX, commodities, inflation, or EM macro products are reported.
criteria.false: Only price or yield moves, economic data, or policy decisions, with no dealer or bank trading activity.

markets.macro.rates.name: Rates
markets.macro.rates.definition: Trading or market making in government bonds, interest-rate swaps, swaptions, futures, options, or related rates products.
markets.macro.rates.label: dealer trading government bonds or interest-rate swaps
markets.macro.rates.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer trading or making markets in government bonds, interest-rate swaps, swaptions, or rates futures and options?

criteria.true: Dealer activity in rates products is reported, such as primary dealer bidding, swap trading, or client rates flows.
criteria.false: Only yield or interest-rate moves, central-bank decisions, or a bank's own balance-sheet hedging.

markets.macro.fx.name: Foreign Exchange
markets.macro.fx.definition: Client-facing trading or market making in spot FX, forwards, FX swaps, options, or related currency products.
markets.macro.fx.label: dealer trading currencies for clients
markets.macro.fx.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer trading or making markets in currencies, FX forwards, FX swaps, or currency options for clients?

criteria.true: Dealer FX trading, client currency flows, or FX derivatives activity by a bank is reported.
criteria.false: Only exchange-rate moves or currency policy, or a bank hedging its own structural FX.

markets.macro.commodities.name: Commodities
markets.macro.commodities.definition: Trading, market making, or derivatives activity in energy, metals, agricultural, or other commodities.
excludes: commodity price move without dealer activity
markets.macro.commodities.label: dealer trading commodities or commodity derivatives
markets.macro.commodities.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer trading commodities or providing commodity derivatives such as futures or swaps?

criteria.true: Bank or dealer commodity trading, hedging for clients, or commodity derivatives activity is reported.
criteria.false: Only commodity prices, supply, or production news, or a bank lending against commodities.

markets.macro.inflation.name: Inflation
markets.macro.inflation.definition: Trading or market making in inflation-linked securities, inflation swaps, or inflation options.
markets.macro.inflation.label: dealer trading inflation-linked products
markets.macro.inflation.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer trading or making markets in inflation-linked bonds, inflation swaps, or inflation options?

criteria.true: Dealer activity in inflation-linked products is reported.
criteria.false: Only inflation data, forecasts, or policy.

markets.macro.emerging_markets.name: Emerging Markets Macro
markets.macro.emerging_markets.definition: Trading in emerging-market sovereign rates, local rates, currencies, or related macro instruments.
excludes: EM currency or bond price move without dealer activity
markets.macro.emerging_markets.label: dealer trading emerging-market currencies or bonds
markets.macro.emerging_markets.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer trading emerging-market currencies, local-currency government bonds, or other emerging-market macro instruments?

criteria.true: Dealer activity or client flows in EM FX, EM rates, or EM sovereign debt are reported.
criteria.false: Only emerging-market price moves or economic news, or lending to EM companies.

markets.credit.name: Credit Markets
markets.credit.question: Which Credit Markets activities are materially described?
markets.credit.definition: Trading, market making, or derivatives activity in corporate or structured credit.
markets.credit.label: dealer trading corporate bonds or credit derivatives
markets.credit.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer trading, making markets in, or structuring corporate bonds, credit derivatives, or structured credit?

criteria.true: Dealer or bank activity in corporate credit, CDS, credit indices, or tranched credit is reported.
criteria.false: Only credit spreads or ratings news, or a company's bond issuance with no dealer trading described.

markets.credit.investment_grade.name: Investment Grade Credit
markets.credit.investment_grade.definition: Trading or market making in investment-grade corporate credit.
excludes: IG bond issuance without secondary trading
markets.credit.investment_grade.label: dealer trading investment-grade corporate bonds
markets.credit.investment_grade.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer trading or making markets in investment-grade corporate bonds?

criteria.true: Dealer trading, inventory, or client flows in investment-grade corporate bonds are reported.
criteria.false: Only spreads or ratings, new bond issuance without trading, or loans.

markets.credit.high_yield_distressed.name: High Yield / Distressed Credit
markets.credit.high_yield_distressed.definition: Trading or market making in high-yield, defaulted, or distressed credit.
excludes: default or bankruptcy news without dealer trading
markets.credit.high_yield_distressed.label: dealer trading junk or distressed debt
markets.credit.high_yield_distressed.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer trading or making markets in high-yield (junk) or distressed debt?

criteria.true: Dealer trading, inventory, or client flows in high-yield or distressed debt are reported.
criteria.false: Only defaults, ratings, or junk-bond issuance without dealer trading.

markets.credit.credit_derivatives.name: Credit Derivatives
markets.credit.credit_derivatives.definition: Trading or structuring CDS, credit indices, tranches, or related derivatives.
excludes: CDS level cited only as a risk indicator
markets.credit.credit_derivatives.label: dealer trading credit default swaps
markets.credit.credit_derivatives.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer trading or structuring credit default swaps or credit indices?

criteria.true: Dealer activity in CDS, CDX, iTraxx, or other credit derivatives is reported.
criteria.false: CDS prices quoted only as a market indicator, or cash bond trading.

markets.credit.structured_credit.name: Structured Credit
markets.credit.structured_credit.definition: Trading or structuring tranched or bespoke credit-risk products.
markets.credit.structured_credit.label: bank structuring tranched credit products
markets.credit.structured_credit.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer structuring or trading tranched or bespoke credit products, such as synthetic CDOs or correlation trades?

criteria.true: Structuring or trading of tranched or bespoke credit risk by a bank or dealer is reported.
criteria.false: Plain corporate bonds, CLO/CDO securitisation of loans, or credit-index trading only.

markets.equities.name: Equities
markets.equities.question: Which Equities activities are materially described?
markets.equities.definition: Client-facing equity trading, market making, derivatives, or structured-product activity.
markets.equities.label: dealer trading or structuring stocks
markets.equities.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer executing, trading, making markets in, or structuring stocks, equity derivatives, or equity-linked products?

criteria.true: Dealer or bank equity trading, execution, derivatives, or structured-equity activity is reported.
criteria.false: Only share-price moves, earnings, or stock-market commentary with no dealer activity.

markets.equities.cash.name: Cash Equities
markets.equities.cash.definition: Client-facing execution, trading, or market making in cash equities.
markets.equities.cash.label: broker executing stock trades for clients
markets.equities.cash.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or broker executing or trading stocks for clients or making markets in shares, such as block trades?

criteria.true: A bank or broker's cash-equity execution, block trade, or market-making activity is reported.
criteria.false: Only share-price moves, index levels, or equity underwriting.

markets.equities.derivatives.name: Equity Derivatives
markets.equities.derivatives.definition: Trading or structuring equity options, futures, swaps, or index derivatives.
excludes: implied volatility cited only as a market indicator
markets.equities.derivatives.label: dealer trading equity options or swaps
markets.equities.derivatives.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer trading or structuring equity options, equity swaps, or index derivatives?

criteria.true: Dealer activity in equity derivatives is reported.
criteria.false: Option prices or volatility levels quoted only as a market indicator, or cash-equity trading.

markets.equities.structured.name: Structured Equity
markets.equities.structured.definition: Structuring or distribution of equity-linked structured products.
markets.equities.structured.label: bank selling equity-linked structured notes
markets.equities.structured.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank structuring or selling equity-linked notes or other structured equity products?

criteria.true: A bank's structured equity products, such as equity-linked notes, are reported.
criteria.false: Plain options or futures, or share offerings.

markets.securitised.name: Securitised Products
markets.securitised.question: Which securitised-products activities are materially described?
markets.securitised.definition: Trading, structuring, warehousing, or distribution of asset-backed and mortgage-backed products.
markets.securitised.label: bank creating or trading mortgage or asset-backed securities
markets.securitised.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer creating, warehousing, trading, or selling mortgage-backed, asset-backed, CLO, or CDO securities?

criteria.true: Securitisation deals, dealer trading, or warehousing of RMBS, CMBS, ABS, CLOs, or CDOs is reported.
criteria.false: Only the underlying loans (mortgages, car loans) with no securitisation activity.

markets.securitised.rmbs.name: RMBS
markets.securitised.rmbs.label: residential mortgage-backed securities deal or trading
markets.securitised.rmbs.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer creating, trading, or selling residential mortgage-backed securities?

criteria.true: RMBS issuance, structuring, trading, or warehousing by a bank or dealer is reported.
criteria.false: Home-loan lending or house prices with no mortgage-backed securities activity.

markets.securitised.cmbs.name: CMBS
markets.securitised.cmbs.label: commercial mortgage-backed securities deal or trading
markets.securitised.cmbs.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer creating, trading, or selling commercial mortgage-backed securities?

criteria.true: CMBS issuance, structuring, trading, or warehousing by a bank or dealer is reported.
criteria.false: Direct commercial property loans or property-market news without CMBS activity.

markets.securitised.abs.name: ABS
markets.securitised.abs.definition: Asset-backed securities activity other than RMBS/CMBS.
markets.securitised.abs.label: asset-backed securities deal or trading
markets.securitised.abs.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer creating, trading, or selling asset-backed securities such as auto-loan or credit-card ABS?

criteria.true: ABS issuance, structuring, trading, or warehousing by a bank or dealer is reported.
criteria.false: Consumer loans themselves, or RMBS/CMBS.

markets.securitised.clo_cdo.name: CLO / CDO
markets.securitised.clo_cdo.definition: Collateralised loan or debt obligation activity.
markets.securitised.clo_cdo.label: CLO or CDO deal or trading
markets.securitised.clo_cdo.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer creating, warehousing, trading, or selling collateralised loan obligations or CDOs?

criteria.true: CLO or CDO issuance, warehousing, structuring, or trading by a bank or dealer is reported.
criteria.false: Leveraged loans themselves without a CLO or CDO.

markets.financing.name: Markets Financing
markets.financing.question: Which client securities-financing or prime-finance activities are materially described?
markets.financing.definition: Client financing through securities finance, prime brokerage, margin, or synthetic structures.
markets.financing.label: dealer financing clients' securities positions
markets.financing.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer financing clients' securities positions through repo, securities lending, prime brokerage, margin loans, or total-return swaps?

criteria.true: Client securities-financing activity by a bank or dealer is reported.
criteria.false: Central-bank repo policy, a bank's own funding, or hedge-fund news without dealer financing.

markets.financing.repo.name: Repo / Reverse Repo
markets.financing.repo.definition: Client securities financing through sale/repurchase or purchase/resale of securities against cash.
excludes: central-bank repo-rate policy without dealer financing
Federal Reserve reverse repo facility usage
markets.financing.repo.label: dealer repo financing for clients
markets.financing.repo.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer providing repo or reverse-repo financing to clients against securities?

criteria.true: Dealer repo or reverse-repo financing for clients, or repo desk activity, is reported.
criteria.false: Central-bank repo rates or operations, or a bank using repo for its own funding.

markets.financing.securities_lending.name: Securities Lending
markets.financing.securities_lending.definition: Client lending or borrowing of securities against collateral.
markets.financing.securities_lending.label: securities lending to short sellers
markets.financing.securities_lending.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or agent lending or borrowing securities for clients, such as stock borrow for short sellers?

criteria.true: Securities lending or borrowing activity by a bank, custodian, or prime broker is reported.
criteria.false: Short interest figures alone, or ordinary secured loans.

markets.financing.prime.name: Prime Brokerage Financing
markets.financing.prime.definition: Financing and related balance-sheet services to hedge funds or institutional clients through prime brokerage.
markets.financing.prime.label: prime brokerage for hedge funds
markets.financing.prime.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank providing prime brokerage financing or services to hedge funds?

criteria.true: A bank's prime brokerage business, hedge-fund financing, or prime client exposure is reported.
criteria.false: Hedge-fund performance or strategy news without the bank's prime brokerage role.

markets.financing.margin.name: Margin Lending
markets.financing.margin.definition: Credit against securities or trading positions to finance client margin or investment positions.
markets.financing.margin.label: margin loans against securities
markets.financing.margin.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or broker lending against securities to finance clients' positions, such as margin loans?

criteria.true: Margin lending, margin calls by a lender, or securities-backed lending is reported.
criteria.false: Unsecured consumer loans, or exchange margin requirements without a lender.

markets.financing.synthetic.name: Synthetic Financing
markets.financing.synthetic.definition: Financing exposure delivered synthetically through derivatives such as total-return swaps.
markets.financing.synthetic.label: total-return swap financing
markets.financing.synthetic.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank financing a client's exposure synthetically through total-return swaps or similar derivatives?

criteria.true: Total-return swap or synthetic prime financing provided by a bank is reported.
criteria.false: Derivatives used purely for hedging with no financing purpose.

markets.derivatives_xva.name: Derivatives / XVA
markets.derivatives_xva.question: Which derivatives, clearing, or valuation-adjustment activities are materially described?
markets.derivatives_xva.definition: Cross-asset OTC or cleared derivatives, client clearing, or XVA/CVA activity.
markets.derivatives_xva.label: bank derivatives, clearing, or CVA
markets.derivatives_xva.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer providing OTC or cleared derivatives, clearing services for clients, or managing derivative valuation adjustments such as CVA?

criteria.true: Dealer derivatives activity, client clearing, CCP clearing by a bank, or XVA/CVA management is reported.
criteria.false: Exchange or regulator news without bank derivatives activity, or derivatives only named in passing.

markets.derivatives.otc.name: OTC Derivatives
markets.derivatives.otc.definition: Bilateral OTC derivative activity not better classified solely by asset class.
markets.derivatives.otc.label: bank over-the-counter derivatives trades
markets.derivatives.otc.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer entering into bilateral over-the-counter derivatives with clients or counterparties?

criteria.true: Bank or dealer OTC derivative trades, exposures, or client OTC business are reported.
criteria.false: Exchange-traded futures only, or derivatives mentioned only in passing.

markets.derivatives.cleared.name: Cleared Derivatives
markets.derivatives.cleared.definition: Derivative activity centrally cleared through a CCP.
markets.derivatives.cleared.label: centrally cleared derivatives trading by banks
markets.derivatives.cleared.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or dealer trading derivatives that are centrally cleared through a clearing house?

criteria.true: Bank or dealer activity in cleared swaps or centrally cleared derivatives is reported.
criteria.false: Bilateral OTC derivatives, or clearing-house news without bank activity.

markets.derivatives.client_clearing.name: Client Clearing
markets.derivatives.client_clearing.definition: Provision of clearing access or clearing services to clients.
excludes: proprietary clearing with no client service
CCP corporate news without bank clearing members
markets.derivatives.client_clearing.label: bank clearing derivatives for clients
markets.derivatives.client_clearing.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank providing clearing access or clearing services to clients for derivatives or futures?

criteria.true: A bank's client clearing or futures clearing business is reported.
criteria.false: Clearing-house or regulator news without a bank clearing for clients.

markets.derivatives.xva.name: CVA / XVA
markets.derivatives.xva.definition: Management, pricing, hedging, or trading of derivative valuation adjustments.
excludes: generic derivatives with no XVA activity
markets.derivatives.xva.label: bank CVA or XVA charges
markets.derivatives.xva.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank pricing, hedging, or reporting valuation adjustments on derivatives, such as CVA, FVA, or XVA?

criteria.true: A bank's CVA, FVA, or other XVA charges, desks, hedging, or losses are reported.
criteria.false: Derivatives activity with no valuation-adjustment element.

markets.underwriting.name: Underwriting / Syndication
markets.underwriting.question: Which underwriting or syndication activities are materially described?
markets.underwriting.definition: Origination for distribution, underwriting, syndication, bookrunning, or placement of debt, equity, or syndicated loans.
excludes: issuance with no bank role described
markets.underwriting.label: banks underwriting a bond, share, or loan deal
markets.underwriting.yes_no_question: Does the article describe banks underwriting, arranging, or running the books on a bond sale, share offering, IPO, or syndicated loan?

criteria.true: Banks are reported as underwriters, bookrunners, arrangers, or placement agents on a debt, equity, or loan deal.
criteria.false: The issuer raises money but no bank role is described, or only secondary-market trading.

markets.underwriting.dcm.name: Debt Capital Markets Underwriting
markets.underwriting.dcm.definition: Underwriting, bookrunning, structuring, or placement of bonds and debt issuance.
excludes: bond sale with no bank role described
markets.underwriting.dcm.label: banks underwriting a bond sale
markets.underwriting.dcm.yes_no_question: Does the article describe banks underwriting, arranging, or running the books on a bond sale?

criteria.true: Banks are named or described as underwriters, bookrunners, or arrangers of a bond or debt issue.
criteria.false: A company sells bonds with no bank role described, or only secondary bond trading.

markets.underwriting.ecm.name: Equity Capital Markets Underwriting
markets.underwriting.ecm.definition: Underwriting, bookrunning, structuring, or placement of equity or equity-linked issuance.
excludes: IPO with no bank role described
markets.underwriting.ecm.label: banks underwriting an IPO or share sale
markets.underwriting.ecm.yes_no_question: Does the article describe banks underwriting or running the books on an IPO, share sale, or convertible bond offering?

criteria.true: Banks are named or described as underwriters, bookrunners, or placement agents on an equity or equity-linked deal.
criteria.false: IPO plans or share sales with no bank role described, or secondary stock trading.

markets.underwriting.loan_syndication.name: Loan Syndication
markets.underwriting.loan_syndication.definition: Arrangement, syndication, distribution, or bookrunning of loans among lenders or investors.
markets.underwriting.loan_syndication.label: banks syndicating a loan
markets.underwriting.loan_syndication.yes_no_question: Does the article describe banks arranging or syndicating a loan across multiple lenders?

criteria.true: A syndicated loan, its arrangers or bookrunners, or loan distribution to lenders is reported.
criteria.false: A single bank's bilateral loan, or a bond deal.

lending.corporate.name: Corporate Lending
lending.corporate.question: Which general corporate-lending activities are materially described?
lending.corporate.definition: General corporate loans and facilities not better classified elsewhere.
lending.corporate.label: bank loan to a company
lending.corporate.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank lending to a company through a general-purpose loan, term loan, or revolving credit facility?

criteria.true: A bank loan or credit facility to a company for general corporate purposes is reported.
criteria.false: Leveraged buyout or acquisition financing, project or asset-specific financing, or company bond sales.

lending.corporate.large.name: Large Corporate Lending
lending.corporate.large.definition: General lending and facilities to large corporate borrowers.
lending.corporate.large.label: loan to a large company
lending.corporate.large.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank lending to a large company through a general-purpose loan or revolving credit facility?

criteria.true: A loan or facility to a large or investment-grade company for general purposes is reported.
criteria.false: Leveraged, acquisition, or project financing, or loans to small businesses.

lending.corporate.middle_market.name: Middle Market Lending
lending.corporate.middle_market.definition: General lending to middle-market corporate borrowers.
lending.corporate.middle_market.label: loan to a mid-sized company
lending.corporate.middle_market.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank lending to a mid-sized company?

criteria.true: Lending to middle-market companies, or a bank's middle-market lending business, is reported.
criteria.false: Loans to large corporates, small businesses, or individuals.

lending.corporate.sme.name: SME Corporate Lending
lending.corporate.sme.definition: Corporate/commercial lending to small and medium-sized enterprises.
lending.corporate.sme.label: loan to a small business
lending.corporate.sme.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank lending to small or medium-sized businesses?

criteria.true: SME or small-business lending, including government-backed small-business loan schemes run through banks, is reported.
criteria.false: Personal loans to individuals, or lending to large companies.

lending.leveraged_sponsor.name: Leveraged / Sponsor Finance
lending.leveraged_sponsor.question: Which leveraged or sponsor-finance activities are materially described?
lending.leveraged_sponsor.definition: Leveraged lending, sponsor-backed credit, acquisition finance, or bridge finance.
excludes: M&A deal with no financing described
lending.leveraged_sponsor.label: leveraged buyout or acquisition financing
lending.leveraged_sponsor.yes_no_question: Does the article describe banks providing leveraged loans, buyout financing, acquisition financing, or bridge loans?

criteria.true: Leveraged lending, private-equity-sponsor financing, acquisition loans, or bridge financing by banks is reported.
criteria.false: An acquisition with no debt financing described, or high-yield bond trading.

lending.leveraged_sponsor.leveraged_loan.name: Leveraged Loan
lending.leveraged_sponsor.leveraged_loan.definition: Leveraged lending to highly indebted or below-investment-grade borrowers.
lending.leveraged_sponsor.leveraged_loan.label: leveraged loan to an indebted company
lending.leveraged_sponsor.leveraged_loan.yes_no_question: Does the article describe banks providing leveraged loans to highly indebted or below-investment-grade companies, such as term loan B?

criteria.true: Leveraged loans, term loan B, or a bank's leveraged-loan pipeline or exposure are reported.
criteria.false: High-yield bond trading, or investment-grade corporate loans.

lending.leveraged_sponsor.acquisition.name: Acquisition Finance
lending.leveraged_sponsor.acquisition.definition: Debt financing used to fund an acquisition, merger, or sponsor-backed buyout.
excludes: general corporate loan unrelated to acquisition
lending.leveraged_sponsor.acquisition.label: loan financing an acquisition or buyout
lending.leveraged_sponsor.acquisition.yes_no_question: Does the article describe banks providing debt financing for an acquisition, merger, or buyout?

criteria.true: Loans or committed financing from banks to fund an acquisition or leveraged buyout are reported.
criteria.false: An acquisition with no debt financing described, or a general loan unrelated to an acquisition.

lending.leveraged_sponsor.bridge.name: Bridge Finance
lending.leveraged_sponsor.bridge.definition: Committed financing intended to bridge a transaction until permanent financing is raised.
lending.leveraged_sponsor.bridge.label: bridge loan for a deal
lending.leveraged_sponsor.bridge.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank providing a bridge loan to fund a deal until permanent financing is raised?

criteria.true: A bridge loan, bridge facility, or bridge-to-bond financing is reported.
criteria.false: Ordinary revolving credit or term loans.

lending.specialised.name: Specialised Lending
lending.specialised.question: Which specialised-lending categories are materially described?
lending.specialised.definition: Asset-, project-, or transaction-specific lending whose repayment is closely tied to the financed project, object, or commodity.
lending.specialised.label: project, aircraft, ship, or commodity financing
lending.specialised.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank financing a specific project, physical asset, or commodity where repayment depends on that project, asset, or commodity?

criteria.true: Project finance, asset/object finance (aircraft, ships), or structured commodity finance by a lender is reported.
criteria.false: General company loans, or project, asset, or commodity news without financing.

lending.specialised.project_finance.name: Project Finance
lending.specialised.project_finance.definition: Financing for a specific project where repayment depends primarily on project revenues, commonly through a project SPV with non- or limited recourse.
excludes: general corporate borrowing by infrastructure company
lending.specialised.project_finance.label: loan for a power or infrastructure project
lending.specialised.project_finance.yes_no_question: Does the article describe lenders financing a specific project, such as a power plant, pipeline, or infrastructure, repaid from the project's own revenues?

criteria.true: Project finance, non-recourse or limited-recourse project debt, or a project-company loan is reported.
criteria.false: General corporate borrowing by an infrastructure or energy company, or project news without financing.

lending.specialised.object_finance.name: Object Finance
lending.specialised.object_finance.definition: Financing of a specific physical asset where repayment depends substantially on asset cash flows or value.
lending.specialised.object_finance.label: financing a specific aircraft or ship
lending.specialised.object_finance.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank financing a specific aircraft, ship, railcar, or other physical asset, with repayment tied to that asset?

criteria.true: Aircraft, ship, rail, or equipment financing or leasing finance tied to specific assets is reported.
criteria.false: Aircraft or ship orders and deliveries, or a general loan to an airline or shipping company.

lending.specialised.commodity_finance.name: Commodity Finance
lending.specialised.commodity_finance.definition: Structured financing of commodity reserves, inventories, production, or transactions where repayment is closely linked to commodity cash flows.
lending.specialised.commodity_finance.label: financing commodity reserves or inventories
lending.specialised.commodity_finance.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank financing commodity reserves, inventories, or trade flows, with repayment tied to the commodity?

criteria.true: Reserve-based lending, structured commodity finance, or inventory financing for commodity traders or producers is reported.
criteria.false: Commodity prices or trading, or a general working-capital loan.

lending.cre.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
lending.cre.question: Which commercial-real-estate lending categories are materially described?
lending.cre.definition: Credit exposures financing commercial real estate, income-producing property, or higher-risk development/construction.
lending.cre.label: bank lending on commercial property
lending.cre.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank lending against commercial real estate such as offices, shopping centres, hotels, or development projects?

criteria.true: Commercial property loans, CRE loan books, or construction and development lending are reported.
criteria.false: Property prices or deals with no lending, CMBS, or home mortgages.

lending.cre.general.name: General Commercial Real Estate Lending
lending.cre.general.definition: CRE lending not specifically classified as IPRE or HVCRE.
lending.cre.general.label: commercial property loan
lending.cre.general.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank making or holding loans secured on commercial property?

criteria.true: Commercial mortgages, CRE loans, or a bank's commercial-property loan book are reported.
criteria.false: Property deals without lending, CMBS, or home mortgages.

lending.cre.ipre.name: Income-Producing Real Estate
lending.cre.ipre.definition: Real-estate lending where repayment materially depends on cash flows generated by the financed property.
excludes: corporate loan not dependent on property cash flow
lending.cre.ipre.label: loan on a rented office, hotel, or building
lending.cre.ipre.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank lending against an income-producing property, such as an office, hotel, or rental building, repaid from its rents?

criteria.true: Loans on rented or income-generating commercial property, where repayment depends on property income, are reported.
criteria.false: Corporate loans not dependent on property income, or construction loans.

lending.cre.hvcre.name: High-Volatility Commercial Real Estate
lending.cre.hvcre.definition: Higher-risk CRE acquisition, development, or construction financing meeting applicable high-volatility treatment.
lending.cre.hvcre.label: construction or development property loan
lending.cre.hvcre.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank financing the acquisition, development, or construction of commercial real estate?

criteria.true: Construction, development, or land-acquisition lending for commercial property is reported.
criteria.false: Loans on completed, stabilised properties.

lending.financial_institutions.name: Financial Institutions Lending
lending.financial_institutions.question: Which financial-institution lending activities are materially described?
lending.financial_institutions.definition: Loans or facilities to banks, broker-dealers, insurers, funds, asset managers, and other NBFIs.
lending.financial_institutions.label: bank lending to financial firms or funds
lending.financial_institutions.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank lending to other financial firms, such as banks, broker-dealers, insurers, finance companies, or investment funds?

criteria.true: Credit facilities or loans from a bank to a financial institution or fund are reported.
criteria.false: Central-bank lending to banks, interbank rates, or trading between dealers.

lending.fi.banks.name: Bank / Broker-Dealer Lending
lending.fi.banks.definition: Credit facilities or loans to banks, broker-dealers, or similar intermediaries.
lending.fi.banks.label: loan to a bank or broker-dealer
lending.fi.banks.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank lending to another bank or to a broker-dealer?

criteria.true: Loans or credit lines from a bank to another bank or broker-dealer are reported.
criteria.false: Central-bank lending, interbank rates, or trading between dealers.

lending.fi.nbfis.name: NBFI / Insurance Lending
lending.fi.nbfis.definition: Lending to insurers, finance companies, asset managers, or other NBFIs not better classified as fund finance.
lending.fi.nbfis.label: loan to an insurer or finance company
lending.fi.nbfis.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank lending to an insurer, finance company, asset manager, or other non-bank financial firm?

criteria.true: Credit facilities or loans from banks to non-bank financial institutions are reported.
criteria.false: Hedge-fund prime brokerage, or lending to investment funds (fund finance).

lending.fi.funds.name: Fund Finance
lending.fi.funds.definition: Lending to investment funds or fund vehicles, including subscription and NAV facilities.
lending.fi.funds.label: credit line to an investment fund
lending.fi.funds.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank lending to an investment fund, such as a subscription line or NAV facility for a private-equity fund?

criteria.true: Subscription lines, capital-call facilities, NAV loans, or other fund-level lending are reported.
criteria.false: Prime brokerage or margin financing of hedge funds, or fund performance news.

lending.sovereign_public.name: Sovereign / Public Sector Lending
lending.sovereign_public.definition: Loans or credit facilities to sovereigns, governments, public-sector entities, or public/multilateral institutions.
excludes: IMF or multilateral programme without bank lending
lending.sovereign_public.label: bank loan to a government
lending.sovereign_public.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank lending to a government, sovereign, or public-sector body?

criteria.true: A bank loan or credit facility to a government, state entity, municipality, or public institution is reported.
criteria.false: Government bond trading or issuance, or IMF/multilateral lending without banks.

lending.trade_working_capital.name: Trade & Working Capital Finance
lending.trade_working_capital.question: Which trade or working-capital finance activities are materially described?
lending.trade_working_capital.definition: Trade-related lending, guarantees, letters of credit, supply-chain finance, receivables finance, and related facilities.
lending.trade_working_capital.label: trade finance or letters of credit
lending.trade_working_capital.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank providing trade finance, letters of credit, guarantees, or supply-chain or receivables financing?

criteria.true: Trade loans, letters of credit, bank guarantees, factoring, or supply-chain finance are reported.
criteria.false: Trade data or tariffs without bank financing.

lending.trade.trade_loans.name: Trade Loans
lending.trade.trade_loans.definition: Short-term lending supporting import, export, inventory, or trade transactions.
lending.trade.trade_loans.label: import or export loan
lending.trade.trade_loans.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank providing short-term loans to finance imports, exports, or traded goods?

criteria.true: Import, export, pre-export, or other trade loans are reported.
criteria.false: General corporate term loans or trade statistics.

lending.trade.lc_guarantees.name: Letters of Credit / Guarantees
lending.trade.lc_guarantees.definition: Documentary/standby letters of credit, guarantees, and similar contingent trade facilities.
lending.trade.lc_guarantees.label: letter of credit or bank guarantee
lending.trade.lc_guarantees.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank issuing letters of credit or guarantees for a client?

criteria.true: Documentary or standby letters of credit, or bank guarantees, are reported.
criteria.false: Funded loans, or government guarantees without a bank issuing them.

lending.trade.receivables_supply_chain.name: Receivables / Supply-Chain Finance
lending.trade.receivables_supply_chain.definition: Financing based on trade receivables, invoices, payables, or supply-chain arrangements.
lending.trade.receivables_supply_chain.label: invoice, factoring, or supply-chain finance
lending.trade.receivables_supply_chain.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank financing a company's invoices, receivables, or supplier payments, such as factoring or supply-chain finance?

criteria.true: Receivables finance, invoice finance, factoring, or supply-chain finance programmes are reported.
criteria.false: Securities financing, or supply-chain disruption news without financing.

lending.consumer.name: Consumer Lending
lending.consumer.question: Which consumer-lending activities are materially described?
lending.consumer.definition: Credit extended to individuals for non-mortgage consumer purposes.
lending.consumer.label: credit cards, car loans, or personal loans
lending.consumer.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or lender providing credit to individuals through credit cards, car loans, or personal loans?

criteria.true: Consumer lending, card balances, auto loans, or personal-loan books are reported.
criteria.false: Consumer spending data without credit, or home mortgages.

lending.consumer.cards.name: Credit Cards
lending.consumer.cards.definition: Consumer revolving credit-card lending and related receivables.
lending.consumer.cards.label: credit-card lending
lending.consumer.cards.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or card issuer lending to consumers through credit cards?

criteria.true: Credit-card lending, card balances, or card loan losses are reported.
criteria.false: Payment processing or debit cards without credit.

lending.consumer.auto.name: Auto Lending
lending.consumer.auto.definition: Consumer lending used to finance automobiles or personal vehicles.
lending.consumer.auto.label: car loan to a consumer
lending.consumer.auto.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or lender financing consumers' car or vehicle purchases?

criteria.true: Auto loans or car finance to consumers are reported.
criteria.false: Car sales without financing, or commercial fleet financing.

lending.consumer.personal.name: Personal Lending
lending.consumer.personal.definition: Personal consumer lending not classified as cards, auto, or residential mortgage.
lending.consumer.personal.label: personal loan to an individual
lending.consumer.personal.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or lender making personal loans or instalment loans to individuals?

criteria.true: Personal or consumer instalment lending is reported.
criteria.false: Mortgages, credit cards, car loans, or loans to companies.

lending.residential_mortgage.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
lending.residential_mortgage.question: Which residential-mortgage lending activities are materially described?
lending.residential_mortgage.definition: Credit secured by residential real estate, including owner-occupied, income-producing residential property, and home-equity credit.
lending.residential_mortgage.label: home mortgage lending
lending.residential_mortgage.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or lender providing home loans secured on residential property?

criteria.true: Residential mortgage lending, mortgage books, or home-equity credit is reported.
criteria.false: House prices or housing starts without lending, or mortgage-backed securities.

lending.mortgage.owner_occupied.name: Owner-Occupied Residential Mortgage
lending.mortgage.owner_occupied.definition: Mortgage lending secured by a residence primarily occupied by the borrower.
lending.mortgage.owner_occupied.label: mortgage for a home buyer
lending.mortgage.owner_occupied.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or lender providing mortgages to people buying homes to live in?

criteria.true: Owner-occupied home-loan lending, approvals, or mortgage books are reported.
criteria.false: Buy-to-let mortgages, mortgage-backed securities, or house prices alone.

lending.mortgage.income_producing.name: Income-Producing Residential Mortgage
lending.mortgage.income_producing.definition: Residential mortgage lending where repayment materially depends on rental or other property income.
lending.mortgage.income_producing.label: buy-to-let mortgage
lending.mortgage.income_producing.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or lender providing buy-to-let or other mortgages on residential property rented out to tenants?

criteria.true: Buy-to-let or rental-property residential mortgage lending is reported.
criteria.false: Owner-occupied mortgages, or commercial property loans.

lending.mortgage.home_equity.name: Home Equity Lending
lending.mortgage.home_equity.definition: Consumer credit secured by accumulated equity in residential property.
lending.mortgage.home_equity.label: home-equity loan
lending.mortgage.home_equity.yes_no_question: Does the article describe a bank or lender providing home-equity loans or lines of credit secured on homeowners' equity?

criteria.true: Home-equity loans or HELOCs are reported.
criteria.false: First-lien purchase mortgages.
